source.notes: f0d8cf4e39 is the last commit with `defineDisplay` alive; the revert 6c6f998a15 came four hours later, so this cannot be re-derived from HEAD. The arms are the two ways of standing a display up at that commit: the factory, which names its chrome and its drawing by value from a module a plugin's install path imports, against `LinearManhattanDisplay/stateModelFactory.ts`, which keeps its component behind React `lazy` — so the difference is what the spec form loads and the hand-composed one does not. Source bytes, not bundled bytes: exactly reproducible from a commit, and the comparison is between two arms measured the same way. ADR-091 states 40 modules / ~240 KB, taken on a branch that no longer exists, against a real port of Manhattan onto the factory rather than against the factory alone.
